probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Alfred Product Company Resources Overview Buy Alfred Sign in Contact Features Pricing Security Customers Blog Overview Buy Alfred Sign in Contact Product Features Pricing Security Updates Changelog Status Incidents Orsini held a fake invoice How a bakery group stopped a supplier scam Company About Customers Contact Legal Terms Privacy Cookies Inside the Valencia studio Where Alfred started, and who works there Learn Blog Help center Customer stories Theme Documentation License No more spreadsheet called final Fjordhus moved every login to passkeys All incidents Delayed email scanning for European accounts Incoming email for accounts in our Frankfurt region was held for up to 40 minutes while a scanning queue recovered. Summary Between 09:12 and 09:52 CET, incoming email for accounts hosted in Frankfurt was delivered late. No email was lost and no unscanned email was delivered. What happened A routine update to our scanning service doubled the memory each worker needed. Workers restarted in a loop, and the queue grew faster than it drained. What we changed Updates now roll out to one worker group at a time. The queue raises an alert at ten minutes of delay, not thirt
